text_block_list.name: Colleague Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—Oh! Speed Symboli-san! Look, she's on the 
news!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: Oh... truly. Active as always, isn't she?

Drinking night with close academy 
trainers. Looking at monitor pointed out 
by colleague, senior trainer murmured 
wistfully.
choice_data_list: As expected of URA Overseas Division Chief

text_block_list.name: Colleague Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Right? Hear it from other trainers too. 
Her work makes overseas campaigns way 
smoother for Japanese horse girls!
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, your trainee also—

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yes. She took very good care of us.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
S-Speed Symboli-san...! To think you flew 
all the way here...! Busy as you are—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it. More importantly, 
how is your horse girl?

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Sitting on the bench over there... She 
seems really shaken... I tried encouraging 
her, but...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Right, I'll go talk to her too. —Now then, 
unexpected equipment breakdown throwing 
off plans. Must have been anxious.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, at this rate training will...! Her 
first expedition, unfamiliar with foreign 
turf—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: It's alright. I understand everything.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
First—how about you and your girl eat 
gaufres together? Nearby stall serves 
exceptionally tasty ones.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Once calmed down, follow me. ...No need to 
worry.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: I will definitely support your challenge.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
And then, she settled things with local 
staff in no time flat—

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Total surprise to them, yet they agreed 
saying 'If it's Speed Symboli's request'. 
Truly... a great figure.
choice_data_list:
So that's how the overseas challenge 
succeeded

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yes! ...Results were harsh, frankly 
speaking. Neither I nor my trainee intend 
to give up, though.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Won't stop challenging. Speed Symboli 
handed us the courage for that!

Afterward, had a lively discussion about 
training menus with senior and colleague 
trainers...

Emptied glass with a spirited 'Let's do 
this!'. Work hard tomorrow with <chrname> again... 
renewed that determination.
